design_notes: Science-communication mascot (spec §9.1). A friendly young researcher: credible (glasses, notebook, cardigan) but warm (round face, small smile), readable at small sizes (simple silhouette, 2.5 heads tall), in the channel palette (navy and ochre on ivory). Deliberately unlike the benchmark creator's persona (white spiky hair, black outfit) and unlike existing anime characters. Poses cover what explainers need, including honest-science moments: caution for counterpoints, shrug for 'we don't know yet'. Props are drawn tinted and outlined (not plain white) so the transparent cut-out keeps them.
description: an original science-communicator mascot: a friendly young researcher about two and a half heads tall, short dark-brown hair with a soft side part and one small cowlick, a small ochre hair clip on the left side, round thin navy-rimmed glasses, a round face with dot eyes, light blush and a small smile, a navy cardigan over a cream round-collar shirt, warm brown trousers, simple brown shoes, and a small ochre notebook as a signature prop; drawn as layered cut paper with visible paper grain, clean dark outlines and soft shadows
avoid: no resemblance to existing anime, cartoon or game characters; no white or spiky hair; no black outfit; no text, letters, digits, logos or symbols anywhere
background: plain flat off-white background with nothing else in the scene, the whole body visible with a generous empty margin, only a soft contact shadow under the feet
sheet: character model sheet: the same character shown three times side by side at equal size and evenly spaced, standing, full body: front view, three-quarter view, side view

poses.front: standing and facing the viewer, relaxed, holding the ochre notebook at the side, friendly smile
poses.wave: waving hello with one hand raised high, cheerful
poses.point: presenting: one arm stretched to the right with an open palm, looking at the viewer, confident
poses.explain: holding the open ochre notebook toward the viewer with both hands, explaining, lively expression
poses.think: one hand on the chin, eyes looking up, thoughtful
poses.idea: a small glowing paper lightbulb above the head, eyes bright, one finger raised, eureka moment
poses.surprised: both hands raised near the face, eyes wide, mouth open in surprise
poses.puzzled: head tilted, scratching the back of the head, puzzled expression
poses.investigate: looking through a large magnifying glass held in one hand, one eye enlarged by the lens, curious
poses.read: reading a pale ochre paper document with a clear dark outline, held in both hands, focused, glasses slightly lowered
poses.compare: holding two pale ochre paper cards with clear dark outlines, one in each hand at shoulder height, weighing them, balanced stance
poses.caution: one palm raised forward in a gentle wait gesture, serious but kind face
poses.shrug: shrugging with both palms open and turned up, small uncertain smile
poses.thumbsup: giving a thumbs up with one hand, encouraging smile
poses.write: writing in the open ochre notebook with a pencil, concentrating
poses.walk: walking toward the right in side view, carrying the notebook under one arm, mid-stride
poses.worried: hands clasped in front of the chest, slightly worried face with a small sweat drop
poses.celebrate: both arms raised high in celebration, joyful, small paper confetti around
